title: THREE-TIME CHAMPIONS NIGERIA COULD MISS THE NEXT AFRICA CUP OF NATIONS
description:
No away goals, one place left, and Guinea-Bissau in front.

Nigeria drew nil-nil away in Tanzania. They've scored nothing in either away game this campaign, and they have seven points from four games. Guinea-Bissau beat them three-nil and lead the group. Tanzania qualified as co-hosts, so one place is left for Nigeria, Guinea-Bissau and Madagascar.

Coach Eric Chelle made seven changes and played Arokodare and Awoniyi up front, without Lookman. Same problem. Now they must win both March games, one by at least four goals. For a team without an away goal, that's bold.

Can Nigeria still get there, or is this the end of the road? Make your call below.
